name: STFD Screenshot Text Forgery Dataset
contents: Mobile Payment and Online Banking smartphone screenshots with five text-tampering types and pixel masks.
reason: Access is password-controlled and the dataset notice limits use to academic research; do not assume production/commercial permission or redistribute images.

name: Automated fake UPI screenshot detection paper
contents: Paper reports experiments on 1,900 genuine and fake UPI screenshots.
reason: The paper page does not provide a downloadable labelled dataset or reusable licence.

name: Find it again! receipt forgery dataset
contents: 988 scanned retail receipts including 163 forged receipts with ground-truth regions.
reason: Physical/scanned retail receipts are materially different from Indian mobile-payment screenshots.

name: GPT4o-Receipt
reason: Gated, non-commercially licensed, and not mobile UPI screenshots.

name: AIForge-Doc v1
contents: Paired authentic and forged receipt/form documents with masks.
reason: Gated/non-commercial and not representative of mobile UPI confirmation screens.

name: AIForge-Doc v2
contents: Paired authentic and forged document images with tamper masks.
reason: Gated/non-commercial and not representative of mobile UPI confirmation screens.
